tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Search published iRap Video templates by name, scene, role, or id. Omits drafts and archived templates. Does not generate a video.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Read one published template page: copy, roles, example media, related published templates, and the public credit offer when this id has one. Does not generate, upload, or charge.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search the public how-to guide and published articles about making a photo rap video. Does not return drafts.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Read the public how-to (slug how-to-make-an-ai-rap-video) or one published article, including its text. Does not return drafts.
